performance.verdict: $634 spent across 28 days; zero leads confirms tracking or intake is broken, not ads.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded across all 28 days despite $634.24 Google spend and 133 clicks — conversion tracking is broken or the landing page is not capturing leads.
5 SOW milestones overdue (Stripe QA Jul 20, GHL build gaps Aug 31, Stack re-test Aug 31, Paid landing pages Aug 31, UGC batch Aug 31) — none show a completion event.
GHL shows 123 opportunities created but 0 leads from ads and 0 appointments — 154 contacts exist with no revenue-path activity, suggesting intake is disconnected from paid traffic.
3-day spend signal (Aug 31–Sep 2: $86.71) is 3× the prior 3-day window (Aug 28–30: $9.10) yet leads remain zero — spend is accelerating into a confirmed black hole.
GBP generated 49 actions (48 directions, 1 web click) and 0 calls over 28 days — organic intent exists but is not converting to pipeline, and paid landing pages are not yet live.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads spend immediately until conversion tracking fires at least one confirmed test lead — $634.24 spent with zero conversions in 28 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $634.24 over 28 days and recorded zero conversions across 133 clicks. Pause all active campaigns and audit the conversion tag end-to-end: fire a test form submission or call, confirm a conversion event appears in Google Ads, and verify the landing page form is functional. Campaigns should not resume until at least one confirmed test conversion is recorded. Re-check by 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Complete the 'Paid Landing Pages Live' milestone (overdue Aug 31) — without it, GBP's 48 direction actions and paid clicks have nowhere to convert.
suggestions.monday_update: The paid landing pages milestone was due 2026-08-31 and shows no completion event. GBP recorded 48 direction actions and Google Ads drove 133 clicks in the 28-day window, both with zero conversions. Web team to deploy and QA the paid landing page with a live form submit test before any ad spend resumes. Confirm live URL and test submission by 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL intake connection: 123 opportunities exist but zero tie to paid traffic — confirm Zapier/webhook path maps ad leads to pipeline before scaling.
